manual_notes: Native spatial gesture code normalizes nonzero axes, uses a near-zero threshold for unconstrained rotation and applies constrained RotateGesture3D for both element types. Scene commands update the axis; the React effect maps missing options to a zero vector and sends property updates, including reset on removal. The selected axis-constraint scope is supported by the cross-layer implementation.
